title: BackendSetError::Other inconsistency: mailbox.rs aborts, email.rs continues
description: In handle_mailbox_set (create/update loops), BackendSetError::Other returns Err(JmapError::server_fail(...)) which aborts the entire Mailbox/set call. In handle_email_set, the same error variant inserts into notCreated/notUpdated and continues. RFC 8620 §5.3 intent is that individual item failures go in the not* maps and processing continues. Inconsistency: same backend error type, different method-level behavior depending on object type.
